Beech Hill Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Boeing Co (BA) by 10.03% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beech Hill Advisors Inc sold 1,831 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,427 shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.39M, down from 18,258 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beech Hill Advisors Inc who had been investing in Boeing Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $216.10B market cap company. The stock increased 0.39% or $1.44 during the last trading session, reaching $370.94. About 2.47M shares traded. The Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) has risen 92.49% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 79.92% the S&P500.
